## What it is

Number 1, rendered blue. Back-left, 135°. Recessed 1. The bar carries the lowest opening, where the straight entry becomes the helix. Four openings: 20.5, 46.5, 72.5 and 98.5 mm above the deck.

## Design notes

- The bar sits on the tube. Each C is cut into the outer face. There is no neck.
- Print it on its side. The flat face is z = 0. The C is the layer outline.
- The mouth opens away from the centre. Press the tube in from outside. The cap can already be on. The inner face of the bar is solid, and the arms stay on that side.
- Bore 13.4 mm, wall 2.4 mm, mouth 11.5 mm. The bar is 10 mm thick, which is the grip along the tube. The bore climbs at the helix angle, 5.4°.
- Both ends of the bar are the plug, 18.2 × 10 mm, into an 18.4 × 10.2 mm slot. Tower 1's key notch is the innermost.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up. That puts the layer lines across the snap.
- Don't leave anything proud of the outer face. The tube has to press straight into the mouth.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: openings cut into the bar. The neck is gone. The foot still fits the old slot.
